biggest_catch: UserCrowd's official help center says each study's incentive is added to your balance on completion — but incentives vary per study with no public numeric band, payouts require a $10.00 balance threshold, and no payout-timing commitment is published.
catches: No public numeric payout band; incentive amounts are set per study.
A $10.00 minimum balance is required before any payout can be requested.
No official payout-timing commitment is published.
Assignments are filled on a first-come basis; volume is not guaranteed.

c1.evidence: Official help center confirms a paid program: 'Each study comes with a monetary incentive that will be added to your UserCrowd balance (in USD) once completed.' (help.usercrowd.com/getting-started-with-usercrowd)

c2.evidence: No public numeric payout band — incentives are per study with no published range.

c3.evidence: No official payout-timing commitment; the $10 threshold adds an unstated wait on top.

c4.evidence: No upfront fee; participants are paid.

eligibility: 18+; a PayPal account that accepts international payments; $10.00 balance threshold for payout
maximize: Only join if you are happy with micro-payments: enable browser push notifications and grab tests the second they arrive, since assignments fill fast and each pays under a dollar. The $10 threshold plus unstated payout timing means this is never fast cash.
notes: Official help center (help.usercrowd.com) fetched 2026-09-23. Reject on variable per-study incentives, the $10 payout threshold, and absent official timing.

s1.note: No public numeric payout band — per-study incentives.

s5.note: Flow documented: complete studies, build balance, request payout.

s6.note: Threshold disclosed upfront; timing not disclosed.
